items.title: Colgate-Palmolive Has Paid a Dividend Since 1895. Does That Streak Still Deserves Your Money?
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive has sent dividend checks without interruption since Grover Cleveland's second term, but a 130-year streak and a shrinking North American business now sit in uncomfortable tension with a premium valuation that leaves almost no room for error.

items.title: Trump: Oil prices will plummet after war ends ‘very soon’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oil prices are set to fall sharply as soon as the war with Iran is over, U.S. President Trump said to reporters on Sunday as he boarded Marine One for Medinah, Illinois, pointing to the already increased oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. He also said that U.S. negotiators are likely to engage in further talks with Iran this week, Axios reported, citing a phone interview.

items.title: Iran insists on diplomacy after Trump rejects Hormuz peace plan
items.summary: Investing.com -- Iran said diplomacy remained the only route to ending its conflict with the United States and Israel after President Donald Trump rejected Tehran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt regional fighting, Reuters reported.

items.title: Is Colgate-Palmolive (CL) Trading Below Fair Value On Cash Flow?
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive has delivered solid gains over recent years, yet the latest pullback in the share price raises a fresh question about what its current valuation really says about the cash it can generate. With the stock recently closing at US$86.06, the issue for investors is how well that tag lines up with the cash flows the business is expected to produce. items.title: Trump administration weighs options to curb record US diesel costs - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Trump administration is actively evaluating a broad slate of emergency policy measures designed to stem soaring domestic diesel prices, ranging from federal tax suspensions to the temporary integration of untaxed off-road fuel supplies. items.title: Saudi, Turkish, Pakistani representatives to meet amid Yemen fighting - Al Jazeera
items.summary: Investing.com - Leaders from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan are planning to meet to discuss ways to aid Riyadh under a joint defense agreement, according to Al Jazeera.

items.title: European equities mostly higher as easing crude overshadow yield spikes
items.summary: Investing.com - European equities snapped back on Friday, recovering from a near one-week low in the prior session as a more than 2% drop in crude oil prices offered relief to energy-intensive sectors and rate-sensitive growth stocks.

items.title: Oil falls on U.S.-Iran truce hopes, Brent set for weekly gain while WTI declines
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oil prices slipped on Friday, halting a two-day climb, after a media report that the U.S. and Iran were exploring a phased deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Traders chose to focus on the report and looked past the lack of any official diplomatic breakthrough between Washington and Iran this week.
